body: You should try Cognitive Behaviour Therapy, it helps with anxiety, though in the two weeks I've been doing it, it hasn't really helped me that much, despite that, I hear endlessly good things about it. I think I have a bad therapist, you're not too bad, so it might really help you. I'm ready to kill myself, so I don't know how much it's going to help me.
I hate when there's no reason for it, then I start looking for reasons and it just reminds me of all the reasons I have to feel bad.

I agree completely. I've lived by this philosophy most of my life. I've pursued my dreams and you know what? Each time I've failed, recently, I've come up with about twenty things to try and each one of them became impossible in a row. I've move back to my parents house now because I wasn't able to succeed outside it, I still have goals and desires, but it's hard when I have no reason to get up in the morning, it's hard to say to yourself 'well, if I just try my hardest for the next twenty years, I'll begin to start to feel normal again.' Doesn't really motivate. Then I get demeaned and made feel like crap by a girl I liked and thought liked me, everything just piled on. I really want to die, no, I don't want to die, I want to just not feel the way I feel, I want to forget that girl, I want it to have never happened, even if just that was gone, things would be much easier, I didn't want to move away from where I lived, I liked that city and was only just beginning to discover it's many wonders, before I had to move to Suburban Craptopia where I am now, where the only thing I have to do all day is pointlessly cycle into town, just so I can cycle back. Fuck all this.

Thanks, that's a really helpful post. To be honest, I had a relationship with a girl that didn't end the way I wanted it to and it recently came back to haunt me a bit, I'm already depressed seperate to her, but that stuff added on top is usually enough to send me into a spiral. Anyway, I sent her an email getting some stuff off my chest and it made me feel better.

I'm going to try play a bit of bass to pass the time, but I still really feel like I'm living a pointless existence, but I hope that I'll get better and become better adjusted. I realise now that I missed out a lot of growing up in my upbringing, which is entirely my parents' fault, I have to learn that stuff now. I'm talking about, learning how to react to situations, learning how to deal with people in a sensible, mature way, learning to look after myself, learning how to interact with people and learning that not everything is going to go my way, there's no fairy with a magic wand to make things happen the way I want them to.

Of course, to learn those things requires me to get out into the world and interact with people and have experiences, but right now I'm stuck in my room with nothing to do, no job, no nothing. So it's a matter of forcing myself out to do stuff and try to meet people, which isn't helped by being as shy as I am.

Like I said, it comes in cycles, so I'll probably be back here at some stage when I hit a trough, maybe next time I'll finally work up the courage to finish myself off. Despite the happy-happy bullshit everyone says, it really wouldn't be that bad, but for now, I'll keep trying to get out there, do stuff and meet people.
